description: This file defines a PHP trait 'MetadataParserTrait' that provides methods to extract headers, header maps, and status code from an HTTP response, specifically tailored for AWS SDK responses.

methods.name: extractHeader
methods.description: Extracts a single header value from the response and converts it based on the provided Shape type.

methods.name: extractHeaders
methods.description: Extracts multiple headers with a specific prefix from the response into a result array.

methods.name: extractStatus
methods.description: Extracts the HTTP status code from the response into the result array.
